outcome_as_recorded:
Signed into law in May 2022, Sam’s Law strengthens anti-hazing policies across colleges and universities. The law mandates that all higher education institutions prohibit hazing in their codes of conduct, provide mandatory hazing prevention education for students, and publicly report violations related to hazing, alcohol, drugs, and physical assault. Additionally, it requires the establishment of a hazing prevention committee that includes students, faculty, and parents to help address and reduce hazing incidents.
